title: Bretton Woods Agreement
description: Delegates from 44 nations establish the post-WWII international monetary order, pegging global currencies to the US dollar backed by gold at $35/ounce.

title: Nixon Shock & Fiat Era Transition
description: President Richard Nixon unilaterally terminates the convertibility of US dollars into gold, ending the Bretton Woods system and initiating floating fiat exchange rates.

references.name: Federal Reserve History: Nixon Shock
references.organization: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis

title: 1987 Black Monday & Greenspan Put Paradigm
description: Following the October 1987 stock crash (-22.6% single day), Fed Chairman Alan Greenspan liquidity injections set the precedent for central bank intervention during market panics.

title: COVID CARES Act & Unprecedented Fiscal Expansion
description: US enacts the $2.2T CARES Act combined with Fed emergency asset purchases, delivering massive direct household transfers and liquidity support.
